projects.name: NeuroPanel
projects.description: A Chrome extension and Next.js backend that captures tab audio in 30-second chunks and transcribes it with Google Gemini. Incremental transcripts are stored in PostgreSQL through Prisma, with secure auth for both the web app and the extension.
highlights: Achieved over 95% transcription reliability with Gemini retry, fallback and error handling.
Extension authenticates with Bearer JWTs, while the web app uses NextAuth sessions.
Sends audio inline up to 20 MB and through the Gemini Files API for larger files.

projects.name: SQRATCH
projects.description: A loyalty and content platform where scratchable QR stickers on physical products unlock branded video and community experiences. Shoppers earn points and redeem them for single-use Shopify discount codes.
highlights: Every point award, spend and refund goes through one atomic ledger function backed by an immutable transaction record.
Creates single-use discount codes live through the Shopify Admin GraphQL API against a brand's connected store.
Role-based access for customers, creators, brand admins and internal staff.

projects.name: WebMCP Forge
projects.description: An open-source no-code studio that scans an existing portfolio and produces one script tag. Once installed, the site exposes real WebMCP tools such as list_projects and get_profile to browser agents.
highlights: Bounded, SSRF-hardened server-side scanner that crawls up to 10 same-origin pages by default.
The runtime reads the live DOM and never calls Gemini or the builder during a tool invocation.
The builder registers its own WebMCP tools, so an agent can operate it.

projects.name: driftguard
projects.description: An end-to-end ML lifecycle that watches itself: train, track and register in MLflow, serve with FastAPI, detect drift and retrain automatically. It is demonstrated on a real distribution shift and evaluated on held-out data.
highlights: Caught concept drift (prediction PSI 0.223) that feature monitoring missed, then retrained and promoted v2, cutting held-out MAE by 44.6%.
Scores both models only on a held-out 2012 slice neither was trained on, so the gain is real generalization.
39 tests against a real MLflow registry, with lint, type checks and a Docker build in CI.

projects.name: AI-SOC
projects.description: A local AI-augmented security operations center. Wazuh-format alerts are triaged by a local LLM grounded in MITRE ATT&CK, network flows are classified by ML models, and analysts review correlated incidents before any rule export or response.
highlights: LLM triage on local Ollama with retrieval over ATT&CK and runbooks, plus Random Forest, XGBoost and decision-tree flow classifiers trained on CICIDS2017.
Viewer, analyst, reviewer and admin roles; analysts cannot approve their own labels, and responses run as dry runs with rollback.
193 offline tests passed; p95 inference latency of 378 ms over 100 concurrent requests.

projects.name: Email Phishing Detector
projects.description: A command-line tool that analyzes .eml and .msg files for phishing. It inspects headers, body and attachments, checks indicators against VirusTotal, and can ask an AI model for a structured phishing score and verdict.
highlights: Header, body and attachment analysis run concurrently with asyncio; VirusTotal lookups are cached in SQLite.
Parses SPF, DKIM and DMARC results and flags brand impersonation and typosquatted links with Levenshtein distance.
OCR reads text from image attachments; the AI step returns a 0–10 score, verdict and suspicious elements as JSON.

projects.name: Fraud Detection
projects.description: Classifies financial transactions as fraudulent or legitimate using 594,643 synthetic BankSim payments, of which 7,200 are fraud. Five classifiers are compared on precision, recall and the real cost of false positives and negatives.
highlights: Cleaned and retyped every column, dropped single-value ZIP fields and one-hot encoded the categorical features.
Compared Naive Bayes, logistic regression, a neural network, a decision tree and a random forest.
Naive Bayes reached 0.9993 recall and the decision tree 0.9027 precision on a 1.2% fraud class.

projects.name: NLP Text Analysis
projects.description: A Streamlit app that analyzes typed text or uploaded PDF, DOCX and TXT files. It extracts tokens, parts of speech, lemmas and named entities with spaCy, scores sentiment with TextBlob and draws a word cloud.
highlights: Two modes: a text analysis dashboard and file-based analysis for PDF, DOCX and TXT.
Token table with shape, part of speech, lemma and stop-word flags, downloadable as CSV.
Most common tokens, named entities, sentiment and a word cloud in one view.

projects.name: onespec
projects.description: One declarative spec drives a compiled client validator, an interpreted server validator and SQL CHECK constraints. A property-based parity suite proves all three accept and reject exactly the same rows.
highlights: 11 tests, including a 10,000-row three-way parity check.
A mutation test shows the parity check detects drift.
No dependencies and no build step; the SQL target runs against SQLite.

projects.name: schemadrift
projects.description: A GraphQL breaking-change gate that downgrades severity using real field-usage telemetry. It names the client that still calls a removed field and posts the report as a pull request comment.
highlights: Removing a deprecated field with zero calls in 30 days is downgraded to SAFE; a field still in use stays BREAKING.
Every downgrade is recorded on the finding with its justification.
A browser app runs the same logic.

projects.name: dmarcwatch
projects.description: Email deliverability monitoring built from DMARC aggregate reports. It separates mail that never arrived from mail that arrived and was ignored, and flags unauthorised senders.
highlights: Parses RUA XML from five provider dialects with a dependency-free reader.
On a seeded corpus, found the planted break day and traced a 100.0% to 15.0% DMARC pass-rate drop to SPF alignment.
Split a 24.0% to 3.6% open-rate drop into deliverability and engagement.

projects.name: tokenforge
projects.description: One design-token JSON source feeds a Tailwind theme, CSS custom properties for light, dark and high-contrast modes, and a typed TypeScript module. A WCAG contrast gate fails CI before a bad color pair ships.
highlights: Validated with Zod, including cross-field reference checks.
check-contrast exits non-zero when a declared pair misses its WCAG level.
104-test Vitest suite; runs fully offline.

projects.name: ContextLens
projects.description: A VS Code extension that shows who wrote a line, why, and what the pull request discussion said. It blames the line, follows the commit to its PR and ranks the comments by how well they explain the change.
highlights: Local SQLite cache (sql.js) makes repeat hovers instant and available offline.
Rate-limit-aware GitHub client with Retry-After and exponential backoff handling.
GitHub token is kept in VS Code SecretStorage, never in settings.json.

projects.name: originbound
projects.description: A contained lab that runs the same real-time relay attack against TOTP and WebAuthn. It shows the attack succeed against one and fail against the other, and names the protocol field that decides the outcome.
highlights: The relay succeeds against TOTP and fails with ORIGIN_MISMATCH against WebAuthn.
A control run with no relay proves the verifier is not simply rejecting everything.
20 tests plus a browser lab.
